The image is backlit by sunlight penetrating the water, creating high contrast and significant blur/motion artifacts. The distinctive T-shaped head (cephalofoil) is clearly visible in profile.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'blur' artifact. In AI images, blur is often uniform or smudged, whereas real motion blur has directionality. Check if the blur aligns with the shark's swimming vector. Also, scrutinize the edges where the shark meets the bright background for any 'haloing' or fusion artifacts common in generative models.
